coverage.method: Every one of the risky sentences was read by Claude after the scope changes. Named features, access and closure dates, climate numbers, counts and superlatives were each judged; those that could be wrong, that change from year to year, or that I could not vouch for from the source list were searched and are listed below.
coverage.notSourcedIndividually: Descriptions of long-established landmarks (for example Sagrada Familia in Barcelona, Table Mountain above Cape Town, the Registan in Samarkand) and well-known climate patterns were judged from general knowledge and not individually sourced. Sources were mostly Park Service, road authority and tourism sites, some conflicting; travel blogs were used for Ladakh winter roads only.
